claims: The Space Shuttle was NASA's first reusable spacecraft program.
The Space Shuttle program operated from 1981–2011.
The Space Shuttle featured a winged orbiter.
The Space Shuttle's winged orbiter launched vertically like a rocket.
The Space Shuttle's winged orbiter landed like a glider.
The Space Shuttle fleet comprised six orbiters total.
The Space Shuttle orbiters included prototype Enterprise.
The Space Shuttle fleet flew 135 missions.
The 135 missions were to launch satellites.
The 135 missions were to conduct science.
The 135 missions were to build the International Space Station.
The Space Shuttle program was retired in 2011.
The Space Shuttle program was retired due to high costs.
The Space Shuttle program was retired due to aging infrastructure.
The Space Shuttle program was retired due to safety risks following the Challenger disaster.
The Space Shuttle program was retired due to safety risks following the Columbia disaster.
